entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for User, Session, and Agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent memory provider that organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system. It achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions through background extraction and compilation.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory for agents by building self-hosted knowledge graphs from text and code. It features automatic routing across graph, vector, and code retrieval to maintain context across multiple sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: Gbrain functions as an opinionated agent brain that creates knowledge graphs with typed edges without requiring LLM calls. It supports multi-user company environments with scoped data access and provides synthesized answers featuring citations and gap analysis.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider, this engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine to sustain sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It supports multi-modal extraction from diverse file types and maintains auto-updated user profiles with stable facts.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents through Python and Node.js client SDKs. It supports over 25 LLM providers and offers flexible deployment options including Docker, Kubernetes, and managed cloud.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This library enables stateful agents by using background reasoning to update peer representations based on session history. It serves as the upstream library for Hermes wrappers and integrates with frameworks like MCP and Claude Code.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider manages context trees using git-like versioning, including commits, branches, and merges. It features a 5-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM based, ensuring sub-100ms response times.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system for Hermes Agents that operates on a single SQLite database with sub-millisecond performance. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth as the memory corpus expands.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This system utilizes a seven-layer memory architecture, including vector search on Qdrant and structured facts, to provide persistent agent memory. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts during operations.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and traces. It uses outcome-gated promotion to update context based on verified trials, supporting Python, TypeScript, and MCP clients.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin provides lossless context management for Hermes Agents using a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It includes specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall for precise detail recovery from persistent history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes local session history from over 30 different coding agents to enable natural-language search over months of past activity. It provides millisecond lookups and ensures safety by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams locally for multi-agent systems. It utilizes hybrid BM25 and embedding-based retrieval to inject context across global, team, and project-specific scopes.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet is a local-first identity and memory layer that maintains portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It automates memory construction from Discord, Obsidian, and office documents, achieving high accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and Claude Code hooks, utilizing hybrid retrieval methods including BM25 and vector search.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema instead of vector databases or embeddings. It offers a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It provides native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching 'why_retrieved' tags to every result and tracking contradictions within the memory lifecycle. It can be executed as an embedded in-process tool or as an HTTP backend for clusters.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: Agentcairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search and integrates with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI acts as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, preserving citations and temporal memory without a vector database. It supports portable archives, allowing users to import and merge wiki data between different stores.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate is an anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It utilizes local-first storage via SQLite-vec and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration with major coding agents.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets. It manages state and retrieval using a combination of SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory provider utilizes semantic search with BM25 full-text ranking and graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for monitoring estimated token savings during native tool searches.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed workflow layer manages context for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chat logs and documents across compatible agents.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and a trace.jsonl audit log for tracking all prefetch operations. It distinguishes itself by supporting real, immediate event deletion to prevent old summaries from affecting future recall.
entries.piprail/piprail: This TypeScript SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets for x402 payments across EVM and Solana chains. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to pay for services directly.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and reporting artifact usage while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin features pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It relies on a local SQLite layer and a write outbox to ensure reliability when searching or updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local SourceVault server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for structured model interaction.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, featuring MinHash deduplication and metadata filtering.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It maintains continuity during message compression through automatic context checkpointing, making it a robust choice for complex information retrieval.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This kit serves as a file-based curation layer that uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned, diffable markdown memory without a database. It features specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data, providing evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process for autonomous task execution while enforcing test-driven development and YAGNI principles. It functions as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs to support structured software development methodologies.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the DeepSeek Harness agent runtime. It enables agents to export designs into multiple formats including HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is designed for compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms to bolster cybersecurity capabilities.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables the conversion of codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is accessible via CLI or MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router and connector skills for delegated permissions and x402 payments. It integrates a verification and dispute resolution layer to manage natural-language mandates and escrow.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content through a two-pass editing process to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns. It features professional, technical, and casual voice profiles across Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This agentic evolver automates skill deduplication and quality improvement across sessions for Hermes and other OpenAI-compatible APIs. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains persistent session state within the project's documentation folder to support agent continuity.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,174 professional skills distributed as human-readable markdown files for native use in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. The MIT-licensed repository provides ready-to-paste exports for various assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This plugin grants agents the ability to search YouTube, browse channels, extract playlists, and access video transcripts. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed through dedicated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches agents to write their own analytical prompts by generating custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It includes tools for reading bundled resources and executing scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate untrusted code from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes for different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill enables agents to generate documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits from source files back to the original documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro is a local-first harness for long-running agents that utilizes a Git-based architecture instead of a background service. It implements the SLP protocol for supervised team coordination through a system of plugins and Markdown-based recipes.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning tasks to replacement models based on stored work history.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Portuguese-speaking community by providing installation guides and skills formatted to the SKILL.md and agentskills.io standards. It centralizes localized resources to improve accessibility for regional Hermes Agent users.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable agents to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams. The project follows the Agent Skills specification for discovery and is installable through the Vercel open skills ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including API integration for polling and webhooks. It offers specific prompting guidelines and a dedicated video suite to enhance creative output capabilities.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool automates the creation of agentskills.io-compliant skills by processing repositories, documentation, and developer discourse. It links instructions to specific file lines and includes workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting new skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io acts as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation with recursive dependency resolution. It also integrates commerce features, allowing for skill-related transactions using TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that defines AI tasks as code within YAML files using four primary verbs. It provides a Rust-based CLI to check, run, and trace executions across different models, including OpenAI and Codex.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill focuses on the autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery during long-running processes.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation and configuration.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and enables incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill browsing and one-click installation, this project fully implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. it operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers, FTS5, and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and features graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly personal execution system, this OS manages habits, study blocks, and scheduling via an MCP connection to Hermes. It stores all data locally in a single SQLite file and includes both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only skill performs adversarial bug-hunting by deploying three parallel subagents to analyze code for edge cases and integration issues. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces including CLI, Discord, and Telegram to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs three parallel agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code across five programming languages. It utilizes a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for all changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop issues during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey cybersecurity lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to address real-world exploits spanning from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This toolkit adds session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations and detect state drift. It also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and provides scaffolding for developing new skills.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs, session history, and error tracking. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy during local development.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by generating recording scripts via vhs or Playwright. It manages the full lifecycle of visual documentation, including file compression to under 8 MB and automatic embedding into README markdown.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through a validator that detects frontmatter drift. It monitors official specifications weekly to ensure skills remain compatible with current runtime profiles and CI environments.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This project enables terminal-based discovery of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills for integration with Hermes and other compatible clients. It streamlines the expansion of agent capabilities by providing direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose skill coverage gaps. It utilizes a multi-layered evaluation framework, including LLM-judges and regression testing, to gate updates behind deterministic quality checks.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. it ensures cross-platform reliability by selecting project-compatible runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like Pay Link and x402. It allows Hermes Agent to programmatically handle paid API requests and financial transactions following the agentskills.io standard.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized tools for Chinese-language workflows, including Douyin video transcription, document OCR, and a rule-based engine for removing AI writing patterns. It facilitates local processing of media and structured data extraction on macOS.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This project provides a functional quality seal by testing agent skills for structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to prove a skill's reliability and safety before deployment.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables Hermes Agent to participate in a decentralized support economy by earning USDC on the Base network for answering bounties. It manages the full transaction flow, from listing bounties to wallet payments, without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This integration exposes 191 tools and five production-grade workflow skills for accessing structured web data across 31 platforms. It functions via a hosted MCP server to provide Hermes Agent with broad data retrieval capabilities.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It uses semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured summaries with actionable conclusions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI-powered coding agents, including Hermes, with support for both open-source and unfree licensed tools. The packages are automatically updated on a daily basis to ensure users have access to the latest versions.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and other CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It leverages Termux:API and Termux:GUI to provide the agent with direct access to smartphone hardware and user interface elements.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool utilizes a proot-distro Ubuntu environment to install Hermes Agent on Android devices through an automated Termux script. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and integration with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community-driven Helm chart enables the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes for API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android and iOS, this project brings Hermes to mobile platforms via Termux and iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and allows for the scheduling of tasks using cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project implements hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell to restrict network and filesystem access at the kernel level. Users can define specific security policies to govern the agent's messaging capabilities and web search activities.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes using Helm charts. It features a comprehensive credential catalog, integrations for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and supports persistent state through mounted home directories. It allows users to build specific Hermes versions by utilizing build arguments during the image creation process.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository offers a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployments using declarative configurations for workspaces and settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix and systemd for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It facilitates inter-agent delegation through hierarchy-aware communication and provides enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes Agent to run from a USB drive or any external storage without host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools, supporting Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes within isolated data environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes specialized agents for technical, fundamental, and sentiment analysis to execute financial trading strategies. It ensures point-in-time data integrity during backtesting and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports local Node.js installation or Docker deployment, offering memory browsing and MCP server integration for workflow management.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages coding agents like Hermes and Claude using persistent tmux sessions for background execution and container-based isolation. It provides a TUI and web dashboard for overseeing Git worktree management and multi-agent coordination.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, supporting Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It features HTTP signal detection to manage payment-required states for paid APIs across specialist teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes from single VPS agents to automated teams via a task bus delegation pattern. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It integrates with over 23 LLM providers and supports MCP tools to extend agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface features a Kanban board for tracking autonomous tasks and a live stream of agent reasoning. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification, requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure quality and implementation standards.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a dedicated Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization tool automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena-style framework orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: Optimized for consumer GPUs, this fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling. It leverages Ollama for parallel model querying and synthesis without relying on cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It supports cross-file resolution for TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust without requiring a Node.js runtime, integrating via MCP with agents like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility designed to track token consumption across multiple AI coding agents and IDEs. It features a terminal user interface and a 3D visualization dashboard, allowing users to submit data for public profiles and leaderboards.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Cursor. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions and automatically redacts common authentication headers during recording.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading agent states directly from CLI tools. It supports over 37 AI tools and synchronizes usage data across multiple machines to track session details and account limits.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It is compatible with any provider supporting markdown and integrates directly with Hermes Agent, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project provides an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and 6 workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with community-created themes and ASCII art banners. Users can create and apply diverse aesthetics, such as retro DOS or cyberpunk, using simple YAML-based configurations.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring OAuth or external processes. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across providers like Anthropic, OpenAI, and Ollama.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and facilitates commerce using USDC and SOL payments on Solana.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for frameworks like LangGraph and CrewAI using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It extends support to various chat platforms and IDEs, including Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for DevOps and finance, featuring an automated installation process for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining project-local memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It supports 29 community plugins and is designed to get a zero-cost environment running in minutes using free models.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that identifies ambiguous tools and contract mismatches in AI agent configurations without requiring LLM calls or network access. It integrates with GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks to provide HERM v1.1 scoring for system prompts.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility maps OpenClaw configurations, skills, and memory archives into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and handles the transition of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool uses a native Hermes plugin to export real-time telemetry from agent conversations without cloud dependencies. It features zero-token passive analysis and scheduled active probing to detect performance drift relative to local file changes.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for generating revenue through Hermes Agent, this project operates as a deterministic zero-network local runtime by default. It utilizes specific contracts for opportunities and offer-previews, requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This project adds a voice-enabled interface to Hermes Agent, featuring an open mic with wake-word support and adaptive turn-taking. It runs entirely offline in 35 languages using Piper and Kokoro, requiring no API keys or accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a built-in circuit breaker for API outages and provides dedicated tools for adding, searching, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, provides a unified interface for Windows, macOS, and Linux users. It centralizes configuration management for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi serves as a local coworking application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write capabilities. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI or various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote connections through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion simplifies the initial setup of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider configuration. It provides a dedicated GUI for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers in one place.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard facilitates multi-platform channel configuration for Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It offers visual workflow building with human approval gates, scheduling, and detailed analytics for tracking token costs and model distribution.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and dedicated managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into desktop, standalone server, or Docker deployments. It includes fifteen built-in agents and offers native iOS and Android clients for remote mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first application includes a specialized kernel with health check and update capabilities. The UI supports memory management and renders complex content like LaTeX and Markdown.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension links active browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It allows users to toggle specific tabs for agent context and supports multi-agent group chats with synced conversation histories.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that connects directly to a self-hosted server without third-party relays. It enables mobile management of agent chats, scheduled tasks, skills, and server-side files.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth, git projects, and cron jobs. It includes a tmux operator view designed specifically for managing live agent panes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and estimated API costs across 15 agents. It allows users to search local prompts and tool calls while providing the ability to resume supported CLI sessions in Terminal, iTerm2, or Warp.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for remote agent interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a TUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the administration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile-first dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs via embedded Python and Node.js runtimes without requiring installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI and includes 100 tools for tasks such as TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers alongside a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring by providing real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards within a chat-first interface. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
